meta.task: Hotel ranking by number of MICHELIN Guide restaurants within 1 hour of travel

method.restaurant_universe: All 24 MICHELIN Guide Southwest 2026 Las Vegas restaurants (data/michelin.json — addresses verified against the official Michelin press release)
method.metric_1_in_hotel: MICHELIN-listed restaurant physically inside the hotel (verified from official hotel pages)
method.metric_2_walk_15: Additional MICHELIN-listed restaurants estimated ≤15-minute walk from the hotel entrance (walking-distance estimates along Las Vegas Blvd between adjacent resorts — ESTIMATE, not an official figure)
method.metric_3_within_1h: Total restaurants reachable within ~1 hour using RTC bus (Deuce/local routes) + walking. Las Vegas has NO subway — bus (RTC) and the private Monorail are the public options (RTC fare page verified). Transit minutes are ESTIMATES pending route-level verification with the RTC trip planner; flagged accordingly.
method.exclusions: Anima by Edo (9205 W. Russell Rd., far southwest) is estimated >1 hour by transit from Strip hotels and is excluded from 1-hour counts (flagged estimate).
sources: official hotel pages for in-hotel restaurant locations

meta.ranking_rule: Primary sort: metric_1 + metric_2 (restaurants inside hotel or ≤15-min walk). Secondary: metric_3. All travel-time figures are estimates and flagged as such per the verification policy.
